measures.label: GDP
measures.origin: national accounts data (statistical offices, central banks, the OECD)
measures.about: The income earned by producing goods and services in the country during the year, in current U.S. dollars.

measures.label: GDP per person
measures.origin: national accounts data (statistical offices, central banks, the OECD)
measures.about: GDP divided by everyone living in the country, in current U.S. dollars.

measures.label: Population
measures.about: Everyone living in the country in the middle of the year, whatever their citizenship or legal status.

measures.label: Life expectancy
measures.about: How long a baby born that year would live if the death rates of that year stayed the same all its life.

measures.label: Science articles
measures.origin: the U.S. National Science Foundation, from Scopus
measures.about: Articles in science and engineering journals and conference proceedings. An article written in several countries is shared between them, so a count can have a fraction.

measures.label: Internet users
measures.about: The share of people who used the Internet, anywhere and on any device, in the last three months.

measures.label: Land area
measures.origin: the UN Food and Agriculture Organization
measures.about: The country's area without its lakes and major rivers, and without the sea it claims.

measures.label: Cereal harvest
measures.origin: the UN Food and Agriculture Organization
measures.about: Wheat, rice, maize and the other cereals harvested for dry grain, in tonnes.

measures.label: Goods exports
measures.about: The goods the country sold abroad during the year, in current U.S. dollars (services are not counted).

measures.label: Goods imports
measures.about: The goods the country bought from abroad during the year, in current U.S. dollars (services are not counted).
